30+ Window Film Brands — Phoenix & Arizona

Arizona House of Film installs film from 30+ manufacturers. We evaluate every project independently — selecting film based on glass type, solar exposure, SHGC targets, and structural requirements. Not brand loyalty.

Ceramic & Spectrally Selective Films

Nano-ceramic and sputtered metallic films represent the highest tier of solar control technology. These manufacturers engineer films that block infrared heat at the molecular level — without the mirror appearance of older reflective films. In Arizona's extreme UV environment, spectrally selective technology is the only solution that delivers heat rejection without sacrificing clarity or signal interference.

Arizona:We specify ceramic films from this group for south and west-facing Phoenix and Scottsdale installations where surface temperatures exceed 160°F.

Safety, Security & Blast Mitigation Films

High-mil safety films are engineered for access denial, blast mitigation, and occupant protection. Film thickness, attachment system, and frame anchoring all determine real-world performance. These manufacturers produce films tested to GSA and DOD standards — the same specifications we apply for schools, government facilities, and high-value retail.

Arizona:We combine these films with wet-glaze anchoring (Dow 995) and C-Bond glass primer for maximum access denial performance — the system we deployed for U.S. Navy Recruitment Centers and Grand Canyon University.

Armor Glass International
Hanita (Avery Dennison)

Decorative, Privacy & Architectural Films

Decorative film technology has advanced beyond basic frosting. Modern architectural films replicate etched glass, sandblasted surfaces, printed patterns, and custom graphics at a fraction of specialty glass cost. These manufacturers supply the films we use for HIPAA-compliant medical privacy, conference room partitions, and branded storefront graphics across Arizona.

Arizona:Trusted for projects with PetSmart, Yoga Six, Wespac Construction, and Transact Commercial Interiors.

Commercial Solar Control & Energy Optimization

Large-footprint commercial installations require films with documented SHGC ratings, NFRC certification, and LEED-compatible performance data. These manufacturers provide the technical documentation required for COMcheck compliance, SRP/APS rebate applications, and green building certification submissions.

Arizona:We provide NFRC data sheets and performance specs across this entire category for GC and architect specifications — relevant for projects with Willmeng, FCI Constructors, and Renaissance Companies.

Saint-Gobain / Solar Gard
Garware Polyester

Custom Specifications & Architect Support

Most window film contractors are locked into 1–2 manufacturer relationships. Our access to 30+ certified brands means we evaluate each project on its technical requirements — SHGC targets, glass type, frame construction, and compliance needs — then select the optimal film.

We provide GCs and architects with:

  • NFRC-rated data sheets for any film in our network
  • COMcheck and LEED documentation support
  • Multi-location specification consistency
  • Custom film sourcing for non-standard applications

Contact us to discuss project specifications.
